human-population-doubling.alt: Line graph of a population of 10 million growing 2% a year for 105 years. Dashed guides mark doubling every 35 years: about 20 million at 35 years, 40 million at 70 years and 80 million at 105 years, as the rule of 70 predicts (70 divided by 2 is 35). Invented example.
